'''Vormur''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of wildflower [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Vormur blooms possessed a pleasant fragrance, and it was not uncommon for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to pick the flowers for their enjoyable scent.<ref name="Revelation" />

Following her revival from [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] freeze, [[Sintas Vel]]—the ex-wife of the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]—stayed on Mandalore for a [[Time/Legends|time]] while she recovered from the effects of [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]]. [[Ghes Orade]], the boyfriend of Vel's granddaughter [[Mirta Gev]], brought a bouquet of vormur blooms to Vel when he came to visit. Though she was temporarily blind as a side effect from the carbonite, Vel enjoyed the vormur flowers' pleasant smell.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vormur blooms were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel, [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Revelation" />
